finalLabel: In this gripping crime thriller scene, set in a dimly lit urban environment, a tense interrogation unfolds between a seasoned detective and a nervous suspect. The setting exudes an air of suspense, with shadows cast across the room, emphasizing the gravity of the situation. The detective, with a stern expression, leans forward, his eyes locked onto the suspect, who shifts uneasily in his chair. The camera employs tight close-ups and strategic angles to heighten the drama, capturing every flicker of emotion on the characters' faces. The low lighting creates an intimate atmosphere, drawing the viewer into the charged exchange. This intense interaction is underscored by a palpable tension, as the detective methodically questions the suspect, probing for the truth amidst a backdrop of urban sounds filtering through the dimly lit room.
